limitations.note: The rewrite fixed the counter rollover but also made `ready_a` high during reset and before the first post-reset clock edge, and suppressed `valid_b` during stalls at count 5; the reference preserves both original behaviors.

The test exercised reset and stalls before the sixth bit, but its expected values encoded the rewrite's always-high `ready_a` and sixth-bit-only `valid_b`, so passing did not establish compatibility with the reference.
